plugins.microphonePermission: Allow BBchat to use your microphone to record voice messages.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow BBchat to access photos you choose to share in chats.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow BBchat to take photos to share in chats.

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow BBchat to import contacts you choose to start conversations.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow BBchat to use your current location when you choose to share it in a conversation.
